card.name: Product-form nouns after drug names
card.fires_on: Dosage-form nouns such as powder, tablet(s) or commodities right after a drug or substance name. Also a few spots partway through words like precipitate and phosphorus.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: The word powder, tablet or tablets follows a drug name in label text.
modes.example: ropterin dihydrochloride<< powder>> for oral solution treatment and periodically for up

modes.label: Partway through chemical words
modes.description: The pole fires on the ending of a longer word such as precipitate or phosphorus.

card.writes: It seems to push toward product-type word endings and compound product terms, with no strong clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on words like powder or tablet that name the form of a drug right after the drug's name.
